corrections.why: 5N-29W-34 reads as a township, range and section code in the source, not an agency name. No source read names an agency for this tower.

notes_for_editor: Thin record. The Forest Lookouts page holds only the name, county and survey code. The Jackson's Ramblings post is the only detail source; it links a Rumble video that was not opened. Built date, staffing, fate and present state are unknown. Record agency '5N' is a survey code, so a correction is proposed. The NHLR Florida list was read in full and Allen is not in it. Check Florida Forest Service or Santa Rosa County records for history and access.
